objective: Dispose derived subscriptions without later queued updates while retaining exact selected values.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Derived stores support observable application state and UI integrations.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Disconnect a selection while preserving independent subscriber ownership.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Cached generic U, snapshot timing, Object.is and lifecycle cleanup transfer.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Fits full selection lifecycle after the get-only checkpoint.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: An already queued source callback can mutate a supposedly disposed view.

defects: Every supplied derived callback could still run after disposal by an earlier source listener in the same notification frame.
Independent derived registrations, opaque frozen-binding semantics and own selected type boundaries were weakly checked.
rationale: Add a disposed guard before select in reference/junior/senior source callbacks, retaining the correct remaining implementation. dispose disconnects once, clears registrations and freezes the cached binding rather than freezing/cloning caller U; ignore an already queued source callback after disposal without selector execution. Preserve minimal source, detached derived methods, independent per-call listeners, idempotent off and snapshot additions/removals; later subscriptions are inert. Callbacks may dispose/register/off but do not throw or mutate the source. At most256live derived registrations/10000source changes; O(n)own time/space,n=live derived count+1,with get/creation O(1),excluding source/selector/payload work and retaining separate prior history bounds. Three cumulative hidden assertions add NaN/signed-zero equality and selection counts,duplicate/snapshot listeners and real-source/external queued-disposal/one-disconnect/exact mutable U. Add visible same-frame disposal and three compiler probes. Independent Map/cache alternative passes; missing guard and any getter passed originals and fail respective new checks.
